function.name: create_callback_request
function.description: Ask the office to call the caller back: a tool failed, they want a person and transfer isn't available, they want to reschedule or cancel, they speak another language, a building-wide system needs office review, they're out of area but think we misheard, or the call can't be finished. One request per call: calling again on the same call updates it (e.g. to add a preferred time).

details.description: Short summary of what the caller needs.

phone.description: Best callback number if different from caller ID. Read it back in groups and get a yes before calling this.

language.description: Caller's language if not English, e.g. 'Spanish', so the office calls back in it.

preferred_callback_time.description: When the caller would like the call, in their words, e.g. 'after 5 PM today'.

context.description: Anything useful already collected (address, issue, chosen window).
